Privacy Policy

Review the current Invonxt privacy notice and how privacy questions should be handled.

Important status

This public page is a review-required policy notice. The service owner must confirm the final production data practices, processors, retention periods, international transfers, and user-rights process before treating it as finalized legal advice.

How this applies

Invonxt necessarily processes account and business information entered by users to provide invoicing and record-management functionality. Access controls—not search-engine directives—must protect private application information.

Questions and requests

For verified privacy requests, use the support options available within the Invonxt application.
